value.title: fleet-map page: test without a DOM, smoke without the omp screenshot

sections.name: body
sections.value:
- The page runs on Chainglass's origin, so treat the data as hostile. Every value placed in HTML goes through esc(). cleanData() on load drops a colour that isn't #rgb/#rrggbb, a pr that isn't a positive integer, and a link that isn't https. The generator applies the same rules (COLOUR_RE, prOf), so a pr can never reach `gh pr view` argv as a flag. The page loads no external fonts or URLs (F253). A test asserts the standalone file has no http(s) or //host in any src, href, @import or url().
- There's no jsdom in node_modules. Test the page's pure functions the way fleet-map.test.ts already does: pageSource("function name(") pulls a top-level declaration out of the template, and new Function(...) evaluates it. That only works for declarations at column 0 that end at a column-0 `}`. For cardHtml, stub L, S, STOP_LABEL, PHASE_LABEL and lineName, and parse the output's tags and attributes as name="value" pairs. Scanning for `name=` matches inside escaped style values and gives false failures.
- dataText() escapes every `<` as \u003c, so the inline block in fleet-map.standalone.html is byte-identical to fleet-map.data.js (F252). Change the fixture, then regenerate golden.data.js with `generate --offline --at 2026-11-17T00:00:00Z`.
- Browser smoke: omp's managed tab.screenshot() hung on this page (it is animated) while tab.evaluate worked. For pictures, run ~/.cache/puppeteer/chrome-headless-shell/*/*/chrome-headless-shell --screenshot --window-size=1600,900 --virtual-time-budget=3000 file://... with its own temp --user-data-dir. tab.hover times out; to open a card, call el.focus() on the [data-key] element (the focusin handler runs showCard).
- Use ABSOLUTE worktree paths in edit/read/write from the first call. My first relative edit landed in main (D-F252-1, sixth strike of D-167-1).
